tickets.title: Prepare life insurance coverage analysis for Mossbutton household
tickets.text: Prepare a life insurance coverage analysis for Alina and Derek Mossbutton reflecting Nora Mossbutton's adoption, Derek's reduced household income during his unpaid leave from Velvet Acorn Pediatrics, the $412,000 remaining mortgage balance, and current coverage: Alina's employer group life at one times her $156,000 salary and Derek's $250,000 term policy with Moonbadger Life through 2041.
